purpose: E1a/E1b single-write-class rows for the host-owned DR group-B published index (+0x38)
gating: core boot latch observed (handshake page +8 == 2 / state CA 0x118b60 == 1 / mask CA 0x40008 == 0)
R0 read-only pack taken and decision D1 (status/ack 0, send words 0, fills 0x10, trig 0)
one value rule per boot; no retry; power-cycle to end

write_class.name: host-owned DR group-B published index

rules.write_value: read each channel's +0x3c (fill) first, then write that same value to +0x38
rules.rationale: restore the vendor working-boot invariant published == fill; the current arm writes 0x400 while the reset-class fill is 0x10
vendor dr_reg_init initial value (pcie_ete_dr_init zeroes inst+0x1C; dr_reg_init stores it to +0x38)

expected_observables: fill(+0x3c) advances past 0x10 and/or host DRAM DR node word1 becomes tagged
hcc_events / dmesg engine fill advance; runes drain without mailbox word
stop_rules: handshake page/state changes from the golden values
no observable change after the 10 s read window -> stop, power-cycle, do not retry in session
